name: 20839-longprefill-bamba9b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; 19.6 GB of weights leaves ample room on one card.
architecture: hybrid state-space + attention decoder (BambaForCausalLM, model_type `bamba`): 32 layers, of which 3 are attention (indices 9, 18, 27) and 29 are Mamba2 mixers; hidden size 4096, MLP intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, context window 262144, 9.78e9 parameters, F16, ~19.6 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 40 requests with a 900 s safety cap; expect roughly 50 s of traffic plus ~20 GB of weight load.
workload: synthetic text, one turn, exactly 32768 prompt tokens and exactly 1 output token on every request (min = max on both axes, so there is no length distribution); `request_format: plain` with no chat template because the checkpoint is a base model, and sampling pinned at vLLM's defaults (temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, `ignore_eos`).
purpose: A document analysis service summarizing 32-thousand-token submissions with a 9-billion-parameter hybrid model, one request at a time on a single GPU.
launch:
model: ibm-ai-platform/Bamba-9B-v2
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 65536
# 36864 = 32768 + one block: below this the prompt is split across scheduler steps.
max-num-batched-tokens: 36864
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enable-chunked-prefill: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
